summary: Sleep in Phong Nha village if the boat cave is why you came. Paradise Cave is the dry walk, on its own ticket.
body: From the Tourism Center the Phong Nha visit is about two and a half hours: a boat down the Son River and into the mouth. The entrance is 150,000 VND and the boat is extra. Paradise Cave is the kilometre on a wooden walk. The park’s adult price is 270,000 VND, buggy included. Vietjet still prints 250,000 VND. Gate hours are check on arrival.

Tam Coc is the low passages, where you may need to duck, with rice and karst on the banks. Sung Sot is the paved cave on many Ha Long boat loops. Nguom Ngao is the lit passage about 4 km from Ban Gioc. Dak Nong’s caves are the Krong No lava tubes. Son Doong is not a stop after the boat cave. Oxalis runs it as six days and five nights, from January to August. The park page and the operator both print 3,000 USD a person. The operator also prints 80,000,000 VND.
Mua Cave in Ninh Binh is a stair climb to the view over rice and karst. The cave itself is secondary.
